en: The Dhāraṇī of the Knowledge of Past Lives Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, the Imperial Envoy, the Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
the Great Master of Illuminating Teaching, the Subject Fa-xian, by imperial decree.
Namo bhagavate acvibhyāya tathāgatāya arhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | Tadyathā | Oṃ akṣaye akṣaye akṣayavarṇe viśodhani svāhā || The Dharani of the Knowledge of Past Lives Spoken by the Buddha.
